notes: Added missing schema/contract and test coverage stories for explainability layer.

stories.title: Explainability Schema Definition (Contract)
stories.description: Define a standardized explainability schema (fields: source, meaning, limitations) using Pydantic models to enforce consistency across all evaluation signals returned by evaluate_care_facade.

stories.title: Explainability Injection into Facade Responses
stories.description: Integrate explainability schema into evaluate_care_facade outputs so all provider and clinical trial responses include structured explanation metadata alongside raw signals.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Explainability Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating that explainability fields (source, meaning, limitations) are correctly populated, normalized, and resilient to missing upstream data across provider and clinical trial signals.

stories.title: End-to-End Validation of Explainability in Chat Responses
stories.description: Validate that explainability metadata flows from backend services through tool_router into frontend chat responses without loss, formatting issues, or rendering errors.
